sector-21: Which metro station is meant for the Sector 21 shopping area?

Akshardham station on the Yellow Line, which opened in January 2026 and was planned to serve the Sector 21 market along with Sectors 10B and 18. Gandhinagar Capital railway station is in Sector 14, so a tutor arriving by train or metro can finish the trip by auto.
Are most Sector 21 tuition homes houses or flats?

Mostly independent houses on planned plots, many on quieter internal roads a short walk from the showrooms, restaurants and cinema. The tutor usually comes straight to the door and parks more easily than on the market frontage. Share the block letter and plot number before the first class.
When is a tuition slot easiest to keep in Sector 21?

A fixed weekday slot agreed in advance, ideally set before the shopping area fills up in the evening. A tutor from neighbouring Sectors 16, 22 or 28 can reach the house without passing the market crowds, which helps lessons start on time through the school year.

sectors-16-22-23: Sector-16 station on the Yellow Line, opened in January 2026 and built for this block of central Gandhinagar. The line continues to Sector-24 and Mahatma Mandir, and Gandhinagar Capital railway station in Sector 14 is the main rail stop for tutors coming from further away.
Why do late-afternoon slots suit families near the Sector 16 offices?

Because government office hours bring weekday traffic at the start and end of the working day around Sector 16, where many state offices stand. A late-afternoon or weekend slot keeps the tutor clear of it, especially for homes in Sectors 22 and 23 beside the Sector 21 shopping area.

The block letter and the flat or house number, plus whether the building asks visitors to sign in at the entrance. Independent houses in these sectors allow doorstep arrival, while flats may keep a visitor register, so a quick note avoids a delay on the first visit.

sectors-25-26: What is the housing like in Sectors 25 and 26?

Sector 25 is mainly residential, with shops, banks and restaurants close by, while Sector 26 holds the state industrial estate, so workshops and small units sit near homes. Government and private housing stand side by side, and most homes open onto the sector roads, so tutors park outside.
Which stations are near Sectors 25 and 26?

Sector-24 station on the Yellow Line, opened in January 2026, lies in the adjoining sector, and Gandhinagar Capital railway station is in neighbouring Sector 14. Sectors 23, 24 and 27 are also next door, so a tutor living in one of them has a short trip by two-wheeler.
Does the Sector 26 industrial estate change tuition timings?

It can. Weekday working hours make the roads around the estate busier, so an early-evening or weekend slot is often easier for the tutor. Families in the same ward, which also covers the area of Randheja village, can follow the same advice when fixing a regular class.
How does NXTutors handle a specialist subject request from Sectors 25 and 26?

sector-30: What kind of housing will a tutor find in Sector 30?

Mostly state government quarters, where many government staff and their families live. Alongside them are independent houses and apartment buildings put up by private builders, plus a few shopping complexes for daily needs. Sectors 28 and 22 and the old town of Pethapur are its neighbours.
How can a tutor find the right quarter in Sector 30?

Share the block and quarter number, since government housing here is laid out in numbered blocks, and give the family's name if the colony has a gate. In apartment buildings, mention the tower and floor instead. Clear directions on the first visit save time for both sides.
Do tutors reach Sector 30 by metro?

Mostly not; tutors here usually travel by two-wheeler or car, because the Yellow Line reaches the central sectors at stations such as Sector-16. NH-147 cuts through Sector 30 and builds up at office hours, so an after-school slot fixed in advance keeps classes on track.
Is switching tutors free for a Sector 30 family?

Yes. If a tutor found through NXTutors stops suiting your child after a few weeks, you can move to another matched tutor without paying anything to switch. Fees are visible before booking, and the first class with any new tutor is a free demo.
pethapur: Is Pethapur older than Gandhinagar itself?

Yes. Pethapur was the seat of a small princely state, and land that once belonged to it became the site of the new capital after Gujarat was formed in 1960. The town was known for block-making, and it joined Gandhinagar Municipal Corporation in June 2020.
How do tutors find homes in Pethapur's older lanes?

With a clear landmark, because the old town lanes are harder to follow than the numbered sectors. Newer bungalow colonies and apartment projects sit beside the old town, and gated colonies may ask visitors to sign in, so tell the tutor which kind of home it is.
Is there a metro station in Pethapur?

No, there is none, and Gandhinagar Capital railway station in Sector 14 is the main rail stop. Most tutors come by two-wheeler or car from Sectors 28, 29 and 30 or from Randheja, so a tutor from one of those neighbouring areas keeps travel simple.
What happens to a Pethapur request on NXTutors?

sectors-2-3: What type of homes are common in Sectors 2 and 3?

Largely independent and duplex houses on planned plots, with government and private homes side by side. Each sector is split into lettered blocks such as Sector 2C, so a tutor visiting a house usually arrives at the door and parks outside without a gate register.
Which metro stations are closest to Sectors 2 and 3?

Sector-1 and Infocity stations on the Yellow Line, both opened in September 2024, run close to these sectors, and city buses stop nearby. Gandhinagar Capital railway station in Sector 14 handles rail travel, so tutors from Ahmedabad or other sectors have several ways in.
How does Infocity office traffic affect classes in Sectors 2 and 3?

Office traffic heading towards Infocity slows the main roads at the start and end of the working day. A tuition slot outside those hours works well, and Sector 1 and Sargasan, which lies next to Sector 3, are the neighbours with the shortest trip.
Will NXTutors show tutors from my own sector first in Sectors 2 and 3?

Yes, NXTutors puts tutors who live nearest at the top, then others in the zone, then the rest of the city, then online tutors. The shortlist has two or three tutors with fees visible, and you can try each one with a free demo class.
sectors-6-7-8: How are addresses read around Sectors 6, 7 and 8?

By the grid, where letter roads cross number roads. The letter roads are K, KH, G, GH, CH, CHH and J, the number roads run 1 to 7, and junctions take names like CH-1 or JA-1. A junction name plus the block and plot number usually guides a tutor straight to the house.
Which tutors live close to Sectors 6, 7 and 8?

Those in Randesan, Raysan, Kudasan and Koba are not far away, since voters from those areas share the municipal ward with these three sectors. Independent houses here allow doorstep arrival and parking at the gate, so a nearby tutor on a two-wheeler is a practical match.
How do tutors reach Sectors 6, 7 and 8 by rail or metro?

Gandhinagar Capital railway station is in Sector 14, and the Yellow Line connects the capital's stations with Ahmedabad. Tutors using either usually finish the trip by auto or two-wheeler, and each sector's own shopping centre makes a simple meeting landmark on the first day.
Can a family in Sectors 6, 7 and 8 mix home and online tuition through NXTutors?

Yes. NXTutors can match a home tutor from nearby for school subjects and an online tutor for a specialist paper, and both show their fees before the first class. Each first class is a free demo, and you can switch either tutor later at no cost.
infocity: Where do families near Infocity usually live?

Mostly in Sectors 2 and 3 and in Sargasan, Kudasan and Randesan, the residential areas around the IT office district. Many IT staff have moved to these areas to live close to work, so tutors often visit flats and houses just beyond the offices.
When did Infocity metro station open?

In September 2024, on the Yellow Line between Sector-1 and Dholakuva Circle stations. A tutor coming from Ahmedabad or from Gandhinagar's sectors can ride to Infocity and walk or take an auto for the last part of the trip to the student's home.
What time of day suits tuition around Infocity?

The late afternoon or the weekend, because office traffic is heaviest at the start and end of the working day. Families in nearby apartment buildings should register the tutor's name at the gate, while houses in the sectors let the tutor come to the door.
Does NXTutors offer online tutors for families near Infocity?

Yes, alongside home tutors. NXTutors shortlists two or three tutors, nearest first and online tutors where a specialist is needed, and shows each fee before you book. The first lesson is a free demo, so you can compare tutors without paying.
vavol: What has changed in Vavol since it joined the city?

It has grown quickly as an apartment area. Vavol was merged into the municipal corporation in June 2020, and dozens of residential projects now stand beside bungalow schemes and the older village core. It shares a municipal ward with Kolvada, and Sectors 4 and 5 are close neighbours.
What should Vavol parents share before a tutor's first visit?

The tower, flat number and a phone number for the gate, since most new homes are in gated apartment societies. That keeps the tutor from being held up at the entrance. In the bungalow schemes or the old village core, a nearby landmark is usually enough.
How do tutors travel to Vavol without a metro station?

Usually by two-wheeler or car along K Road or the Uvarsad–Vavol Road, with NH-147 close by linking Vavol to Infocity and Sargasan. Roads towards the highway are busier at office hours, so fix an after-school slot in advance and keep it steady.
Where does NXTutors look first for a Vavol tutor?

kudasan: Which metro stop do tutors use for Kudasan?

Sector-1 station on the Yellow Line is the usual stop for the area, so tutors coming by metro finish the trip by auto or two-wheeler. Kudasan also sits close to SG Highway and the Koba road that links Ahmedabad with the capital.
Are Kudasan homes mostly flats or plotted houses?

A mix of independent houses, plotted developments and apartment buildings, with flats making up much of the newer building. For apartments, share the tower and flat number with the guard in advance; at plotted houses the tutor can come straight to the door.

sargasan: Which station is used for Sargasan?

Infocity station on the Yellow Line, which runs one way to Mahatma Mandir in the heart of the capital and the other way to Motera Stadium in Ahmedabad. Gandhinagar Capital railway station serves rail travel, and tutors usually finish the trip by auto.
What should a Sargasan family tell the guard before tuition starts?

The tutor's name, plus the tower and flat number, since most visits are to gated apartment societies. Housing is mainly two- and three-bedroom flats, with some independent homes and residential plots where the tutor can simply come to the door and park outside.
How did Sargasan become part of Gandhinagar city?

It was one of the villages merged into Gandhinagar Municipal Corporation in June 2020. Town planning schemes shared with Kudasan, Por, Dholakuva, Vavol and Vasna Hadmatiya have shaped its growth, and it lies beside Infocity and Sector 3, close to SG Highway.
How much does home tuition cost for a Sargasan family on NXTutors?

randesan: Does Randesan have its own metro station?

Yes. Randesan station on the Yellow Line opened in September 2024 and sits between Dholakuva Circle and Raysan stations. A tutor can ride from Ahmedabad or the sectors and walk or take an auto for the last stretch to a Randesan home.
Why do many IT staff live in Randesan?

Because Infocity is close by, and the Ahmedabad–Gandhinagar Road (SH-71) and the Gandhinagar bypass road both connect the locality. Housing is mainly apartment buildings, with three-bedroom flats the most common and some bungalow colonies, so tutors mostly visit gated societies.
When is SH-71 easiest for a tutor heading to Randesan?

Outside office hours, since SH-71 is busiest at the start and end of the working day. Evening classes work better when fixed for a time after the rush. In gated societies, give the guard the tutor's name in advance; at bungalows the tutor comes to the door.

raysan: What kind of homes are there in Raysan?

Multi-storey apartment buildings, villas, row houses and residential plots. Raysan has filled with them since June 2020, when it came within Gandhinagar city limits. Gated societies need the tower and flat number at the gate, while villas and row houses usually allow doorstep arrival.
Which metro line can a Raysan tutor use?

The Yellow Line, which has a Raysan station opened in September 2024. The next stop is where the branch to GIFT City begins, which suits tutors who live along either line. SH-71 is also close, and the road towards GIFT City passes nearby.
When should Raysan families schedule tuition?

After the evening rush or at the weekend, because peak traffic towards GIFT City and Ahmedabad shapes timings here. Koba, Randesan and Adalaj are all neighbours, so a tutor from one of them can usually keep a fixed weekly slot.

koba: How many metro stations carry Koba's name?

Three, all on the Yellow Line: Koba Circle, opened in April 2025, and Juna Koba and Koba Gaam, opened in September 2025. With stations on hand, a tutor from either Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar can travel by metro and walk or take an auto from the station.
Which homes do Koba tutors usually visit?

Apartments from two to five bedrooms, plus independent homes. Gated societies usually ask for the visitor's name, so tell the guard in advance, while at independent homes the tutor comes straight to the door. Several town planning schemes cover Koba with Kudasan and Raysan.
How does SH-71 affect class timings in Koba?

Office traffic on SH-71, the Ahmedabad–Gandhinagar Road, peaks early and late in the working day, so fix the class time around it. Koba lies between Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar, which means tutors from either side can be considered for a regular weekly slot.

gift-city: What are homes like in GIFT City?

Flats in high-rise towers, many of them twenty-five storeys or taller. The district is planned on the bank of the Sabarmati, and new residential projects are still being added. A little over a fifth of GIFT City's planned built-up space is residential, set beside offices and community facilities.
How does a tutor get into a GIFT City tower?

Through building security at the gate or lobby, so the family should register the tutor and share the tower and flat number in advance. The towers have controlled entry, and arranging this before the first class keeps the free demo from starting late on the day.
Which metro line reaches GIFT City?

The Violet Line branch, opened in September 2024, which runs to GIFT City station and connects with the Yellow Line to Gandhinagar's sectors and Ahmedabad. An extension beyond GIFT City towards Shahpur has been approved but is not yet open, so plan trips around the current stations.
Is online tuition a good option for GIFT City families?

It often is, because weekday office traffic is heavy at the start and end of the working day. NXTutors suggests the nearest home tutors first and online tutors alongside them, two or three matches in all, each with a fee shown and a free first demo.
adalaj: At the meeting point of the Sarkhej–Gandhinagar Highway, part of NH-147, and State Highway 41, which cross at a cloverleaf interchange in the middle of the town. Adalaj is a census town in Gandhinagar district, raised from village status in 2001.
Which metro station do tutors use to reach Adalaj?

Tapovan Circle station on the Yellow Line is the usual stop, because the metro does not reach Adalaj itself. From there a tutor takes an auto or a pick-up. Raysan, Vadsar and Bhat, and Gota and Chandkheda on the Ahmedabad side, are close neighbours.
Are Adalaj homes bungalows or apartments?

Both. Bungalow schemes line the highway and apartment projects are growing towards Vaishnodevi Circle. At bungalows the tutor can come straight to the door, while gated projects need the visitor's name at the gate, and highway traffic at office hours makes late-afternoon or weekend classes easier.
